profile.ja: 世界各地に支部を持つロシアンマフィア「ホテルモスクワ」のロアナプラ支部の女ボス。若き頃、オリンピック射撃種目の選手を目指し、旧ソ連空挺軍に入隊したが、アフガニスタン侵攻に出征させられてしまう。火傷顔（フライフェイス）、全身の火傷跡はその戦線の時に負ったものらしい。主な部下はそのとき共に戦った遊撃隊のメンバーから構成されている。
profile.en: She is the female boss of the Roanapura branch of the Russian mafia "Hotel Moskva", which has branches all over the world. In her youth, she aimed to be an Olympic shooting athlete and joined the former Soviet airborne troops, but was sent to fight in the Afghan invasion. Her burned face and full-body burn scars are said to have been sustained during that time. Her main subordinates are composed of members of the reconnaissance team who fought alongside her back then.

text.ja: あなたが隊長さん？　初めまして、私のことは“バラライカ”と呼んでちょうだい。この街で戦争を始めるなら私と私の部隊は役に立つわ
text.en: You're the captain? Nice to meet you, call me "Baralaika". If you're going to start a war in this town, I and my troops can be of use to you.

text.ja: 私の『ホテル・モスクワ』は立ち塞がる全てを容赦しない。それを排撃し、殲滅する。あなたにそれを仕切る勇気はあって？
text.en: My "Hotel Moskva" shows no mercy to anyone who gets in our way. We'll eliminate them without hesitation. Do you have the courage to give us those orders?

text.ja: 私はただの商売人よ。あなたたちと同じく経済活動で利潤を追及する。違うのは、扱うのが『恐怖』と『暴力』ということだけ
text.en: I'm just a businesswoman. I pursue profits through economic activities, just like you. The only difference is that I deal in "fear" and "violence".

text.ja: アサギとはあの砂漠の戦場で出会ったわ。最初に見た時は、何か凄い恰好をしてる……と思ったけれど、実力は申し分なかったわね
text.en: I met Asagi on that desert battlefield. At first, I thought she looked quite something, but her skills were undeniable.

text.ja: 正義という言葉は私も好きよ。掲げるお題目は空虚なほど明るく輝くものだから
text.en: I like the word "justice" too. The slogan we uphold is bright and empty.

text.ja: あなたも指揮官を志すなら覚えておきなさい。いずれその肩は、失った命で取り返しのつかないほど重くなる
text.en: If you're going to be a commander, remember this: one day, the weight of the lives you've lost will become unbearable.

text.ja: 我々は無様な亡者だ。最後の一片の誇りまで奪われ、生者への怒りと妬みで満ちている。せいぜい引きずられぬように心するのだな、隊長殿
text.en: We're a miserable bunch, stripped of our last shred of pride, filled with anger and resentment towards the living. All we can do is try not to be dragged down, Captain.

text.ja: 殺し合い、奪い合うのはこの世の常――それを理解していても、ひどく疲れる時がある。特に、お前たちのような子供の死を見た時には
text.en: It's just the way of the world - we kill and take from each other. Even if I understand that, it can be exhausting at times. Especially when I see the death of children like you.
